pages.title: Smelter Spirits
pages.text: Smelter spirits are summoned to do furnace, blast furnace, smoker and campfire process,$(br)without using fuel. They will pick up appropriate items and drop the resulting into the world.$(br)A fire particle effect and a flame sound indicate $()

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: To ease automation, try summoning a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items)Transporter Spirit$(/l) to place items from chests$(br) in the smelter's inventory, and a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner)Janitor Spirit$(/l) to collect the processed items.$(br)

pages.title: Foliot Smelter
pages.text: The foliot smelter is the most basic smelter spirit.$(br2)It will smelt an item at the same speed as the furnace.$(br)

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
